name: Love Peace Harmony
headline: From an idea-stage crossroads
to a de-risked plan.
summary: A global non-profit needed to define a new member platform. A focused workshop, a working prototype and a clear scope-versus-budget plan made the next decision possible.

image.alt: Love Peace Harmony donation page with gift amounts and donor details.

challenge.title: Knowing the mission, but not the technical build.
paragraphs: Love Peace Harmony was at the idea stage of a major decision: a new member platform. The team knew its goals inside out but had no way to judge the technical build.
They needed to know what to build, what it would cost, and how to reach a working first version without risking budget on the wrong product.

approach.title: A focused, business-first workshop.
paragraphs: We led the decision-makers through business-first questions, capturing the product from the member’s point of view — what people click, see and do — rather than in technical language.

outcome.next: A realistic roadmap of the time and money for the next phase: the full build.
